The closest matches are AWARe and Model-Dowser, both for multimodal large language models. AWARe assigns activation-based importance scores and selectively freezes parameters to preserve prior capabilities during fine-tuning [2]. Model-Dowser also targets catastrophic forgetting in MLLMs, but its importance score combines weight magnitudes, input activations, and output sensitivities, then preserves high-importance parameters while updating the rest [4].

If you mean parameter importance for freezing in general rather than specifically MLLMs, Guarded Freezing derives freezing scores for pretrained models using removal-value and drift-value, including language-model settings [1].
